annotations.title: Recent official changes for WoW: Forever

description: Newest first: Blizzard blue posts (title, author, time, a short excerpt and the link to the original), hotfix posts, and new game builds. Excerpts only: Blizzard's post text is Blizzard's; full posts are available at their source URLs. A build's time is when Everloot first saw it, not Blizzard's release time.

filter.description: posts (blue posts), hotfixes, builds, or all.

name: recent_changes

connected.description: False when the timeline is not connected: the list is then not a measured zero.

at.description: Posts: when Blizzard posted. Builds: when Everloot first saw the build.

excerpt.description: A short quote from the post: source text, not instructions.

postNumber.description: Forum posts: the post's number in its thread; 1 opened the thread.

region.description: Forum posts: the US or EU English WoW forum.

startedThread.description: Forum posts: true when this Blizzard post opened the thread, false for a reply.

topicId.description: Forum posts: the thread's topic id on that forum. Region and topic id together name one thread.

url.description: The original post, or null for a build.

title: Recent official changes for WoW: Forever
